messages:
Anita: Hey team — starting a tiny refresh of the 'Starter Grove' quickstart. Goal: simplify first-deploy auth flow, add a small WS example, and fix the broken embed link in step 3. Keeping it minimal for first-time devs.
Jordan: SGTM. Any changes to env var names? we should avoid breaking existing samples.
Anita: Yes, propose RW_API_KEY instead of REDWOOD_API_KEY to match SDK examples. Will add a short migration note in the top-of-docs callout.
Sam: Quick note — the docker-compose.yml in ./samples/grove mounts .env but the README uses a different var name; I hit an auth error locally.
Anita: ugh. Can you paste the error?
Sam: "401 Unauthorized: missing Authorization header" when running `docker compose up` after I set `RW_API_KEY=` in .env.
Luis: I can fix samples and run CI smoke tests. Can we add a tiny websockets example for realtime echo? 1-file example.
Maria: If we add WS, keep the same auth header pattern. Also need to update the "sdk-js" snippet to the new async iterator streaming API.
Anita: Good call. Proposed edits:
- swap env var name to RW_API_KEY
- add WS snippet (hello-grove-ws.js)
- update SDK JS snippet to use async iterator
- fix link to "deploy-prod" doc (anchor was broken)
Jordan: Tagging DocsBot to make sure link check runs: @DocsBot please run link-check on PR
DocsBot: Link check queued for PR #7890 — running
Sam: I pushed a draft in PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7890
Anita: thanks. Who can review the JS snippet? Jordan?
Jordan: I can review tomorrow. Also add a small note about token rotation and KMS hint.
Luis: CI failure on sample run: `npm ci` in samples/grove fails due to node v16 vs v18. I'll add an "engines" field in package.json and mention node v18 in README.
Maria: For the WS example, here's a minimal snippet:
```js
// hello-grove-ws.js
import WS from 'ws';
const ws = new WS('wss://ws.redwood.ai/v1/realtime', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.RW_API_KEY}` } });
ws.on('open', () => ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'hello', model: 'grove-mini' })));
ws.on('message', m => console.log('evt', m));
```
Jordan: Nice. Keep the snippet under 25 lines.
Anita: Plan: push changes to branch `docs/starter-grove-refresh`, add PR description bullets, request Jordan and Luis for reviews. Aim to merge by EOD Friday.
Sam: I can do a final local smoke test once CI passes.
Luis: I'll run integration tests on dedicated infra tomorrow morning.
Anita: Great — updating PR description now. Please add :eyes: when you review.
Jordan: :thumbsup:
DocsBot: Link check passed for PR #7890
Anita: Thanks all, closing loop — will ping again if anything blocks.
